A gitoid of type blob is a unique hash of a binary artifact. A gitoid may represent either an [Artifact Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-identifier-types) for the software artifact or an [Input Manifest Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#input-manifest-identifier) for the software artifact's associated [Artifact Input Manifest](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-input-manifest); this ambiguity exists because the Artifact Input Manifest is itself an artifact, and the gitoid of that artifact is its valid identifier. Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 384, as defined in [RFC 6234](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc6234/).
Denote whether a CVE is present in an exploit catalog.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dynamicAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a dynamic analysis report for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ismn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Music Number (ISMN)](https://ismn-international.org/ismn/the-ismn/) is a unique numeric identifier for printed music (notated music) standardized by [ISO 10957](https://www.iso.org/standard/83122.html). It consists of either 10 characters (starting with the letter "M" for assignments prior to January 1, 2008) or 13 digits. A 13-digit ISMN is composed of four parts: the GS1 prefix `979-0`, a registrant element, an item element, and a check digit. While elements may be divided by spaces or hyphens for human readability, these separators shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `9790006538424`).
Records if sensitive personal information is used during model training or could be used during the inference.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: publishedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` Vulnerability was made available for public use or reference by each `to` Agent.
A prescribed change to a product's location.
Regulation represents a rule or directive maintained by an authority.
Identifies who or what created the Element.
Specifies the SPDX License List version in which this license or exception identifier was deprecated.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/Hardware/Hardware is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Identifies the full text of a License, in SPDX templating format.
A mapping between prefixes and namespace partial URIs.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/Core/Location is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: query
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is publicly available, but not all at once, and can only be accessed through queries which return parts of the dataset.
Specifies the VEX justification type.
Identifies the full text of a License or Addition.
Specifies a vulnerability and its associated information.
Provides advise on how to mitigate or remediate a vulnerability when a VEX product is affected by it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDeclaredLicense
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Artifact was discovered to actually contain each `to` AnyLicenseInfo (for example, as detected by automated tooling).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: test
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during an element's testing phase, during development.
Class that describes an instance of VirtualHardware.
Class that describes an instance of Hardware.
This individual element was defined by the spec.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: other
Authentication protocol used by a server.
The boundary definition is used to define boundaries.
Records the biases that the dataset is known to encompass.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/SimpleLicensing/AnyLicenseInfo is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: mailingList
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the mailing list used by the maintainer for a package.
Conveys information about how VEX status was determined.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: binaryArtifact
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to binary artifacts related to a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any other specialized or custom verification method that fits the context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: build
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during an element's build phase, during development.
This is the planned individual, business, or organization who currently manages goods, services, or assets.
Provides an ExternalMap of Element identifiers.
This process is used to determine the state of an affected Element.
A Package that contains AI software or an AI model.
An assumptionUUID is a universally unique identifier (UUID) assigned to an Assumption item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: manifest
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software manifest.
A short description of an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: buildSystem
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a build system used to create or publish the package.
Identifies the tooling that was used during the creation of the Element.
A mathematical algorithm that maps data of arbitrary size to a bit string.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: module
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a module of a piece of software.
Use Process defines actions used by elements.
This individual element was defined by the spec.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasRequirement
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a requirement on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
An entity that is authorized to issue identification credentials.
A rationale is supporting information that provides the underlying justification or reasoning for an associated element, decision, or process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: text
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data consists of unstructured text, such as a book, a Wikipedia article (without images), or a transcript.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: test
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a test used to verify functionality on a software element.
Temporary endeavor with a beginning and an end and that must be used to create a unique product, service or result.
This class represents the process involved in manufacturing products.
Confidentiality level of the data points contained in the dataset.
A collection of Elements, not necessarily with unifying context.
Specifies the type of a content identifier.
Describes a certain part of a file.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: audit
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An examination typically focusing on compliance with policies, standards, or regulations. Usually this is done during an audit meeting, while the assessment also involves deep and detailed reviews of work products (e.g. requirements, verification specifications, reports etc.)
Abstract ancestor class for all vulnerability assessments.

It is the authoritative or credible entity, document, or body of knowledge that provides the meaning of an additionalInformation key and/or its values, ensuring accuracy, context, and standardization.
Provides a CVSS version 2.0 assessment for a vulnerability.
A key with an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: core
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Core profile specification.
Describes a relationship between one or more elements.
Refers to any unit of content that can be associated with a distribution of software.
Identifier for specific product is called a serial number.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: purchaseOrder
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a purchase order for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasOptionalDependency
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element optionally depends on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Process plans outline the stages of implementation or use related to a process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element doesn't fit into any of the other categories.
A map of Element identifiers that are used within an SpdxDocument but defined external to that SpdxDocument.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Other exploit catalogs.
The DefinedType class associates a specific type with its defined source.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: usesTool
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element uses each `to` Element as a tool, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Methods that can be used to explain the results from the AI model.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: obsolete
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: superseded or not valid at present

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: altDownloadLocation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an alternative download location.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasAddedFile
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a file added to the `from` Element (`from` hasAddedFile `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: timestamp
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is recorded with a timestamp for each entry, but not necessarily ordered or at specific intervals, such as when a taxi ride starts and ends.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: video
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is video based, such as a collection of movie clips featuring Tom Hanks.
Specifies the time when a vulnerability was published.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: testedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been tested on the `to` Element(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: trackStar
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: ("Track\*" in the SSVC spec) The vulnerability contains specific characteristics that may require closer monitoring for changes. CISA recommends remediating Track\* vulnerabilities within standard update timelines.
A license that is listed on the SPDX License List.
Prescribes the storage of a product.
Identifies the nature of the contactPointRelationship.
An actual change to a product.
The AssemblyProcess represents the process of creating a product by assembling a set of components, potentially in a way that allows for at disassembly (at least partially).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ancestorOf
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is an ancestor of each `to` Element.
Identifies an external Element used within an SpdxDocument but defined external to that SpdxDocument.
Defines the version of a specific process.
UnitofMeasure specify information structures through industry standards for Units of Measure, Quantity Kinds, Dimensions and Data Types.
A collection of Elements that have a shared context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityAdversaryModel
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the security adversary model for a package.
A physical location is a tangible, geographically identifiable place where objects, people, or assets exist or operate.
Specified the time and date when a vulnerability was withdrawn.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: blake2b256
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: BLAKE2b algorithm with a digest size of 256, as defined in [RFC 7693](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc7693/) Section 4.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: kev
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerability (KEV) catalog.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: finetunedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been finetuned on the `to` Element(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: library
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software library.
Refers to any object that stores content on a computer.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: software
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Software profile specification.
An individual human being.

rdf:Description.sh:message: Class is known to not derive from Extension and cannot be used

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing this version, or any later version, of the indicated License.
The provider of a SoftwareService.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: review
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A examination or checking of documentation, records, processes, or systems to confirm compliance or adherence with an upper level requirement. Typically done as peer review, offline review or review meeting.
A key with an associated value.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: green
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset can be shared within a community of peers and partners.
Describes how an Agent provides support for an Artifact.
A place for the SPDX document creator to record a website that serves as the package's home page.
Energy consumption incurred by an AI model.
Provide context for a relationship that occurs in the lifecycle.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: mavenCentral
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Maven repository artifact. The artifact locator format is defined in the [Maven documentation](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-naming-conventions.html) and looks like `groupId:artifactId[:version]`.
It is the authoritative or credible entity, document, or body of knowledge that provides the meaning of a type, ensuring accuracy, context, and standardization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: lexid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: LEX Identifier is a Uniform Resource Name (URN) for sources of law within the [LEX namespace](https://www.iana.org/assignments/urn-formal/lex), as defined in [RFC 9676](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9676/) (e.g., `urn:lex:it:stato:decreto.legislativo:2018-08-10;101`).
A value used in a generic key-value pair.
Identifies from where or whom the Element originally came.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: copiedTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been copied to each `to` Element.
Unit of energy consumption.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: image
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is a collection of images such as pictures of animals.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: resolved
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `to` OutOfSpecAction is resolved in the `from` ResolutionAction.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: issueTracker
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the issue tracker for a package.
Information related to hardware dimension.
An element of hardware and/or software utilized to carry out a particular function.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: md4
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: MD4 message-digest algorithm, as defined in [RFC 1186](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1186/).
The number that identifies a PO box. A PO box is a box in a post office or other postal service location assigned to an organization where postal items may be kept.
A state is an instance that describes what a system, component, subsystem, process, or project has achieved at any given time.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: lei
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The [Legal Entity Identifier (LEI)](https://www.gleif.org/en/organizational-identity/introducing-the-legal-entity-identifier-lei) is a 20-character, alphanumeric code based on the [ISO 17442](https://www.iso.org/standard/78829.html) standard developed by the International Organization for Standardization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_224
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-3 with a digest length of 224, as defined in [FIPS 202](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/202/final).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: trainedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been trained on the `to` Element(s).
Hyperparameter used to build the AI model contained in the AI package.
A specification type defines the nature of a specification.
A collection of SPDX Elements that could potentially be serialized.
Designates elements as products where the impact of a vulnerability is being investigated.
Date of product release.
Agent represents anything with the potential to act on a system.
Impact justification label to be used when linking a vulnerability to an element representing a VEX product with a VexNotAffectedVulnAssessmentRelationship relationship.
Specifies a human language used within the content of an Element or a property.
Type of the model used in the AI software.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: x509Cert
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an X.509 certificate as defined in [RFC 1422](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1422/). The media type shall be one of application/x-x509-ca-cert or application/x-x509-user-cert.
Abstract class representing a License or an OrLaterOperator.
Expression for the export control classification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: deployed
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM provides an inventory of software that is present on a system. This may be an assembly of other SBOMs that combines analysis of configuration options, and examination of execution behavior in a (potentially simulated) deployment environment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fail
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates a failed evaluation where the requirement or condition is not met.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha1
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-1, a secure hashing algorithm, as defined in [RFC 3174](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3174/).
A canonical, unique, immutable identifier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isan
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Audiovisual Number (ISAN)](https://www.isan.org/about/#what_is_isan) is a unique 24-digit hexadecimal identifier for audiovisual works standardized by [ISO 15706](https://www.iso.org/standard/83124.html). The ISAN remains persistent for a work regardless of its distribution format or its use. To facilitate human readability, the "ISAN" label, grouping hyphens, and two check characters are included (e.g., `ISAN 0000-0000-3A8D-0000-Z-0000-0000-6`); however, these elements shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `000000003A8D000000000000`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fullAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 5 - Full automation. The system is capable of performing its entire mission without external intervention.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A generic contact point to be used when the contact type does not match any of the other options.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: altWebPage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an alternative web page.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: specification
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A specification is a detailed document (or set of documents) that describes the requirements, design, behavior, or other characteristics of a system, component, or process so that all stakeholders have a clear, unambiguous reference.
Information related to virtual hardware simulation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: doesNotAffect
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Vulnerability has no impact on each `to` Element. The use of the `doesNotAffect` is constrained to `VexNotAffectedVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: executable
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is an Artifact that can be run on a computer.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: funding
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to funding information related to a package.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/Core/IntegrityMethod is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Specifies the CVSS vector string for a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: verificationUUID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The UUID used by a verification management system or any other lifecycle management tool to uniquely identify a verification item. UUID, or universally unique ID, is a standard term to refer to verification items.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: tls
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Transport Layer Security, or TLS, is a widely adopted security protocol designed to facilitate privacy and data security for communications over the Internet.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasMetadata
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is metadata about the `from` Element (`from` hasMetadata `to`).
Hazards are potential sources of harm, danger, or adverse effects to people, property, the environment, or systems within or related to a specific piece of hardware.
Defines the level of automation a system possesses.
Threshold that was used for computation of a metric described in the metric field.
Indicates whether a relationship is known to be complete, incomplete, or if no assertion is made with respect to relationship completeness.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasPrerequisite
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a prerequisite on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Specifies a country code where a software service is hosted.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: no
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates absence of the field.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: data
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is data.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: clickthrough
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is not publicly available and can only be accessed after affirmatively accepting terms on a clickthrough webpage.
An actual change to a product's location.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: componentAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Software Composition Analysis (SCA) report.
Provide consumers with comments by the creator of the Element about the Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtimeAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a runtime analysis report for a package.
The name of the recipient expressed in text.
Title of the project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: limitedSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact has been released, and there is limited support available from the supplier. There is a validUntilDate that can provide additional information about the duration of support.
Provides an independently reproducible mechanism that permits verification of a specific Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: lite
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Lite profile specification.
Provides a NamespaceMap of prefixes and associated namespace partial URIs applicable to an SpdxDocument and independent of any specific serialization format or instance.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityOther
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to related security information of unspecified type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: modifiedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is modified by each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasInput
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Build, DefinedProcess or Action element has each `to` Element as an input.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: numeric
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data consists only of numeric entries.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any other units of energy measurement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inlineMitigationsAlreadyExist
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Built-in inline controls or mitigations prevent an adversary from leveraging the vulnerability.
The location for picking up a package or item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iswc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Musical Work Code (ISWC)](https://www.iswc.org/iswc) is an 11-character unique identifier standardized by [ISO 15707](https://www.iso.org/standard/83125.html) for musical works (compositions) as distinct from specific recordings. While the "ISWC" label and grouping separators (dots and hyphens) are used for human readability, they shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `T0017812031`).
Availability of a dataset.
A license or addition that is not listed on the SPDX License List.
Verification postcondition that are true immediately after a verification method has been performed

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: md5
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: MD5 message-digest algorithm, as defined in [RFC 1321](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1321/).
A contact point from an Artifact to an Agent.
Provides an unambiguous mechanism for conveying a URI fragment portion of an Element ID.
Specifies the exploit catalog type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used to store extra information about an Element which is not part of a review (e.g. extra information provided during the creation of the Element).
The relative file name of a file to be excluded from the `PackageVerificationCode`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: rorid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Research Organization Registry (ROR) identifier](https://ror.org/about/) is a unique identifier for research and funding organization, typically expressed in its preferred URI form such as `https://ror.org/02mhbdp94`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: formalStandard
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A formal standard is a standard ratified by a recognized standards-development organization and published as a normative reference.
A class for describing the energy consumption incurred by an AI model in different stages of its lifecycle.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: categorical
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data that is classified into a discrete number of categories, such as the eye color of a population of people.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: conformsTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element conforms to each `to` Assumption or Specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: staticAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a static analysis report for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bom
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a bill of materials related to a package.
A reference to a resource outside the scope of SPDX 3 content related to an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: registration
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is not publicly available and an email registration is required before accessing the dataset, although without an affirmative acceptance of terms.
EvaluationResult is the result of an evaluation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bic
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Business Identifier Code (BIC), also known as SWIFT-BIC or SWIFT code, is a unique 8 or 11-character alphanumeric code standardized by [ISO 9362](https://www.iso.org/standard/84108.html) to identify financial and non-financial institutions (e.g., `BBWCUS33`).
A string in the license expression format.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: invokedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element was invoked by the `to` Agent, during a LifecycleScopeType period (for example, a Build element that describes a build step).
Specifies the time an artifact was built.
Class that describes an action that has occurred.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: socialMedia
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a social media channel for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: generates
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element generates each `to` Element.
Provide an enumerated set of lifecycle phases that can provide context to relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: graph
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is in the form of a graph where entries are somehow related to each other through edges, such a social network of friends.
A text describing the actual need defined by the requirement.
Harvest is the process of extracting goods or products from nature.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: crl
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Certificate Revocation List, or CRL, is a list of revoked certificates that is downloaded from the Certificate Authority (CA).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: simpleLicensing
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the SimpleLicensing profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: configures
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is a configuration applied to each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: none
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is 0.0.
A group of people who work together in an organized way for a shared purpose.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityAdvisory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a published security advisory (where advisory as defined per [ISO 29147:2018](https://www.iso.org/standard/72311.html)) that may affect one or more elements, e.g., vendor advisories or specific NVD entries.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/Core/ElementCollection is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: foundBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` Vulnerability was originally discovered by the `to` Agent(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_256
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-3 with a digest length of 256, as defined in [FIPS 202](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/202/final).
Provides information about the type of an SBOM.
An out of specification action is defined in this class.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: follows
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `to` Element succeeds the `from` Element, establishing a unidirectional sequence. This succession is defined as chronological, procedural, or logical. It is used to represent either a temporal order (e.g., in a workflow) or a logical order for processing and traversal (e.g., in an ordered list).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dependsOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element depends on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Type of data in a dataset.
Provides a numerical (0-10) representation of the severity of a vulnerability.
An SPDX version 2.X compatible verification method for software packages.
Provides an exploit assessment of a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ecli
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [European Case Law Identifier (ECLI)](https://data.europa.eu/data/datasets/european-case-law-identifier-ecli) is a uniform identifier for judicial decisions across Europe. It consists of five mandatory components: the "ECLI" prefix, a country code, a court code, the year of the decision, and a unique serial number (e.g., `ECLI:EU:C:2023:94`).
Identifies the name of an Element as designated by the creator.
The CreateProcess refers to the abstract process class that can be used to represent the process of creation of a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: source
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a single or a collection of source files.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: license
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to additional license information related to an artifact.
An Organization representing the SPDX Project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gitoid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Gitoid](https://www.iana.org/assignments/uri-schemes/prov/gitoid), stands for [Git Object ID](https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Git-Internals-Git-Objects). A gitoid of type blob is a unique hash of a binary artifact. A gitoid may represent either an [Artifact Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-identifier-types) for the software artifact or an [Input Manifest Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#input-manifest-identifier) for the software artifact's associated [Artifact Input Manifest](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-input-manifest); this ambiguity exists because the Artifact Input Manifest is itself an artifact, and the gitoid of that artifact is its valid identifier. Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).
